ccsd.description: Detects Claude Code extension auto-updates and silently re-applies the cc-status-dot patch, plus a CC Favorites view for pinning files and CC sessions (v0.4.0+) and editor tab right-click favorite toggle (v0.5.0+). Ships inside the vscode-claude-code-status-dot npm package — install via: npx vscode-claude-code-status-dot

ccsd.config.notify.description: Show a notification when Claude Code completes a turn (state transitions to done or interrupted).
ccsd.config.notifyWhenFocused.descriptio: Also fire the completion notification when VSCode is the currently focused window. Disable to only notify when you're in another app.
ccsd.config.notifySound.description: macOS system sound to play on completion notification (ignored on Linux/Windows).
ccsd.config.tokenStatsWindow.description: Time window for the right-side token stats status bar item. 'all' = cumulative (never resets, default); the rolling windows (5min..30d) naturally age out old turns. Match this default with the IIFE cfg.get fallback (pin enforced by test-version-sync.mjs).
ccsd.config.tokenDisplayMode.description: What to show on the token stats SBI: token count only, USD cost only, or both.
ccsd.config.tokenSbiVisible.description: Show the token stats status bar item on the right side.
ccsd.config.tokenLiveDeltaEnabled.descri: Read the active session's transcript tail every tick so token counts update during streaming (between hook fires). Disable on perf-sensitive machines.
ccsd.config.showCost.description: Show the USD cost estimate alongside the token count (requires a matching model entry in token-rates.json — unknown models like GLM are auto-hidden).
ccsd.config.warnThresholdUsd.description: Notify when the session cost estimate crosses this USD threshold (0 = disabled). Fires once per crossing.
ccsd.config.rateDisplayMode.description: How to render the live tok/s suffix on the token status bar item: 'off' hides it (for crowded bars / perf-sensitive machines), 'numeric' (default) shows only '1.2k/s', 'sparkline' shows only '▂▄▆█', 'both' shows both. The rate segment is '·'-separated like cost (renders '12.3k tok · 1.2k/s · ~$0.42').
ccsd.config.fav.includeInExplorerContext: Show 'CC Favorites: Add/Remove File' in the Explorer file right-click menu.
Show 'CC Favorites: Star/Unstar Current CC Tab' on non-file editor tab right-click menus (v0.5.0+; v0.5.1 relaxed the gate from webview-only to non-file so the item surfaces on the Claude Code tab — VSCode exposes no CC-specific context key, and the CC tab's resourceScheme resolves to empty, not 'webview'). The handler no-ops with an info message when the active tab is not a Claude Code session (no __ccsdActiveSid).
